disclosures: The 18 instances are a filtered subset of SWE-bench Verified (allowlisted repositories, a simple-fix filter, a round-robin cap, gold-validation pruning and a fixed seed). The result is not the published Verified score.
These public instances were probably seen in training; the number does not predict performance on unseen issues.
Tiny sample: 18 instances, 3 runs each. The runs of one instance are strongly correlated, so 54 rows carry far less evidence than 54 independent trials.
The six pytest instances pass in every run and make up a third of the instances; without them the baseline rate is lower.
Every run used --no-pr: no pull request was opened, so nothing here measures PR opening.
35/54 is a hand-stated substitution of sweep-4 (29/54 officially, 12 rows lost to Vertex 429) and sweep-4b (the re-run of those rows).
e1, r2 and m1 had their rows lost to 429 archived and re-run in place; the baseline used a separate re-run. Spend on those archived attempts is added back and shown both ways.
Sweep-5 and r1 are partial and are shown for completeness only: never compared on a rate.
Model prices are Google AI Studio list rates, not billed Vertex rates.
meta.rules: Generated under .claude/rules/benchmark.md: no run is pooled, intervals are over instances, comparisons use run_index 0 and exact McNemar, partial runs are marked and never compared on a rate.

header: chunk MRR vs baseline [95% interval over instances]
Reading the grid.prose: Primary metric: chunk MRR. Pick a strategy over truncate / truncate only if its paired chunk MRR gain is at least 10 percentage points with the 95% interval over instances excluding 0. This is one of 7 comparisons, on the same instances the agent is benchmarked on, so a winner is exploratory: with this many cells on this few queries one always looks better.

By repository.prose: Gold hunks no indexed chunk overlaps: 0. They are dropped from the chunk metrics and not scored as misses; the chunk metrics credit only a hunk's innermost chunks. Chunks written across the run (first instance of each repo/strategy is the full index): 376412.

retrieval.reading: No strategy met the pre-set switch rule (a 10-point chunk-MRR gain with the 95% interval over instances excluding 0); the default stays truncate.

power.basis: 80% power, two-sided alpha 0.05, normal approximation with the instance-bootstrap standard error
power.reading: with 18 instances a comparison of two configurations needs a gap of about 40 points to be called clearly different

methods.name: Headline pass rate
methods.detail: planned is the manifest grid (instances x runs); every planned row that is not a pass is a non-pass.

methods.name: Bootstrap over instances
methods.formula: resample the 18 instances with replacement 20,000 times; rate = sum passes / sum planned; 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles
methods.detail: Runs of one instance are not independent, so rows are never resampled.

methods.name: Wilson interval over rows
methods.detail: Shown only to display how much clustering widens the interval.

methods.name: Intraclass correlation and design effect
methods.formula: ICC(1) = (MSB - MSW) / (MSB + (m - 1) MSW); design effect = 1 + (m - 1) ICC; effective n = rows / design effect

methods.name: Cochran's Q across run indexes
methods.formula: Q = (k - 1) [k sum C_j^2 - T^2] / [k T - sum R_i^2]
methods.detail: Tests whether run 0, 1 and 2 differ in pass rate.

methods.name: Exact McNemar test (pre-registered)
methods.formula: two-sided binomial test of min(b, c) in b + c discordant pairs at p = 0.5
methods.detail: On run_index 0, over the instances scored in both runs; discordant counts always shown.

methods.name: Holm correction
methods.formula: p(i) adjusted = max over j<=i of (m - j + 1) p(j)
methods.detail: Across the three variants (e1, r2, m1).

methods.name: Paired cluster bootstrap of the difference
methods.formula: resample instances; difference in passes out of 3 per instance

methods.name: Exact sign test and Wilcoxon signed-rank
methods.formula: binomial test on instances better vs worse; Wilcoxon on per-instance pass-count differences

methods.name: Sign-flip permutation test
methods.formula: 20,000 random sign flips of the instance differences
methods.detail: Exchangeability of the paired differences under the null.

methods.name: Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio
methods.formula: sum(a d / n) / sum(b c / n) over instance strata; Robins-Breslow-Greenland variance
methods.detail: Only instances where both condition and outcome vary inform it; the six always-passing pytest instances do not, so it is often undefined.

methods.name: AUC for first-edit step
methods.formula: P(first edit of a passing task < first edit of a failing task)
methods.detail: Descriptive: hard instances need more investigation before the first edit.

methods.name: Not computed, and why
methods.detail: Eighteen items and a handful of runs cannot support a difficulty model; a pooled posterior overstates certainty at an ICC of about 0.7.

baseline_claim_check.plan_said: the baseline ran on the shortest retry window
baseline_claim_check.found: sweep-4's manifest sha f02ccb3c57 is the merge of PR #50 (b661a30), which already set max_attempts = 9; sweep-4, sweep-4b, r2 and m1 all ran on 9 attempts. The plan's claim is WRONG: the baseline did not run on a shorter window than r2 and m1. Only e1 rows started after the window commit ran on 21.
